pages.brief: Ned the yellow duckling waddling across still green grass near a big oak tree under a calm blue sky.
Ned the duckling looking up at oak leaves beginning to swirl in a rising wind, grey clouds appearing at the edge of the sky.
Ned the duckling looking worried under a darkening sky, oak leaves and loose twigs blowing sideways around him.
Ned the duckling scurrying fast towards the thick trunk of the big oak tree, wings half spread, wind blowing his feathers.
Ned the duckling tucked safely among the thick roots of the big oak tree while rain falls heavily outside the shelter.
Ned the duckling peeking out from the oak tree roots into bright sunshine breaking through the branches above, looking happy.
